title: Control Room
summary: The air-conditioned production nerve center stationed two doors down Jinhua Street. Monitors glow across folding tables, and comms headsets hiss with quiet radio traffic.
inspect_text: The control room is chilled to sixty-six degrees to keep the switcher racks and tape decks from sweating. Three folding tables hold eight high-definition reference monitors cycling through camera feeds of the Da'an villa. A whiteboard on the wall tracks daily call sheets, audio frequencies, and the cast's lavalier numbers. Through the heavy curtains, the humid Taipei heat feels a million miles away.

features.label: switcher desk
features.inspect_text: Eight Sony reference monitors display live feeds from the villa: kitchen island, dining table, lounge terrazzo, and rooftop terrace. The switcher board's illuminated tally lights glow soft amber.

features.label: production whiteboard
features.inspect_text: A dry-erase board scrawled with network directives, microphone battery logs, and today's schedule for Maya, Chika, and Toby.

features.label: headset comms station
features.inspect_text: Three multi-channel radio headsets hang from metal hooks. Channel 1 links directly to Chika's walkie-talkie behind the villa walls.

title: Jinhua Lane 183
summary: A tranquil residential lane paved with grey interlocking bricks, lined with flowering bougainvillea, potted ferns, and parked vintage scooters.
inspect_text: The lane is quiet enough to hear banyan leaves rustling in the breeze and the low rumble of an MRT train deep underground. Potted monstera, flowering magenta bougainvillea, and laundry hanging behind historic iron grilles line the facades of the old three-story townhouses. Two doors down is the villa entrance; behind you is the rented production control room.

features.label: bougainvillea trellis
features.inspect_text: Vibrant magenta bougainvillea climbs the weathered concrete wall of the neighboring townhouse, dropping papery petals onto the grey pavers.

features.label: parked vintage scooters
features.inspect_text: A row of parked scooters: Kai's vintage Yamaha SR150 with weathered leather saddlebags, Chika's green scooter with a scratched helmet, and two quiet electric Gogoros.

title: Genkan
summary: The sunken terrazzo entryway of the villa. A bench of reclaimed camphor wood sits beneath geometric 1970s iron window grilles.
inspect_text: Polished grey concrete steps drop down from the front door into the genkan. Reclaimed camphor wood forms a low bench where street shoes are exchanged for leather indoor slippers. Geometric 1970s iron grilles frame frosted begonia glass, casting patterned shadows across the floor. The open kitchen and living room extend just beyond the threshold.

features.label: camphor shoe bench
features.inspect_text: A thick, fragrant slab of camphor wood. Beneath it sit six pairs of shoes: Ren's oiled kitchen clogs, Kai's worn Chuck Taylors, Mio's platform boots, Daichi's carbon running shoes, Aera's minimalist sandals, and Yuhan's leather mules.

features.label: leather slippers
features.inspect_text: A wooden rack holding simple tan leather slippers for moving silently across the villa's terrazzo and wooden floors.

features.label: iron window grilles
features.inspect_text: Historic Taiwanese security grilles twisted into geometric floral motifs, holding panes of frosted begonia glass that blur the alleyway outside.

title: Open Kitchen
summary: A central stainless-steel island with commercial gas burners, overhead copper racks, and deep sinks. The culinary heart of the house.
inspect_text: Professional stainless steel dominates the space, balanced by warm teak cabinets and matte black fixtures. A commercial four-burner gas range sits beneath an industrial range hood. Beside the prep sink rests a neat wooden pour-over coffee station, a glass-door beverage fridge, and Ren's canvas knife roll, laid out with clinical precision.

features.label: stainless-steel island
features.inspect_text: A massive brushed stainless-steel prep island with commercial gas burners and an end-grain wooden chopping block. It's built for two people to cook side-by-side—or bump shoulders uncomfortably.

features.label: pour-over coffee station
features.inspect_text: A brass Hario dripper, a goose-neck kettle with digital temperature readout, and a matte black conical burr grinder. A glass jar holds fresh medium-roast beans from a boutique roaster in Zhongshan.

features.label: glass-door refrigerator
features.inspect_text: A commercial glass-front refrigerator stocked with cold oat milk, bottles of Taiwanese sparkling mineral water, fresh Yilan mountain greens, tofu cakes, and several bottles of natural orange wine.

title: Dining Room
summary: A solid Taiwanese cypress ten-seater table under low ceramic pendant lamps. Where group meals and quiet standoffs occur.
inspect_text: The ten-foot dining table is cut from a single reclaimed slab of Taiwanese cypress (hinoki), smooth and faintly fragrant. Ten wishbone chairs surround it. Three fluted ceramic pendant lamps hang low over the surface, casting a warm 2400K pool of light that makes every glance and hesitation across the table impossible to hide.

features.label: cypress dining table
features.inspect_text: The long cypress table bears the natural grain of mountain timber. It is large enough for all six housemates to dine together, yet intimate enough that foot-touches and subtle eye-rolls are instantly noticed.

features.label: fluted pendant lamps
features.inspect_text: Low-slung handmade ceramic lamp shades in matte terracotta, casting pools of warm golden light over the table while leaving the surrounding room in soft shadow.

title: Sunken Living Lounge
summary: Sunken into emerald-flecked terrazzo. A long low modular sofa, floor cushions, and art monographs, with no TV in sight.
inspect_text: Three shallow concrete steps descend into a sunken floor of polished emerald-and-white flecked terrazzo (mo-shi-zi), delightfully cool beneath bare feet. A deep, modular slate-grey linen sofa wraps around two sides of the space. There is deliberately no television; low teak bookshelves hold art monographs and photography collections, and floor-to-ceiling iron glass doors open out into the verdant courtyard.

features.label: low modular sofa
features.inspect_text: A low-slung, ultra-deep sofa upholstered in textured slate linen. Floor cushions allow three or four people to lounge in close proximity without having to sit upright.

features.label: travertine coffee table
features.inspect_text: A low slab of porous cream travertine. At any given hour, it holds half-empty mugs of roasted barley tea, sketchbooks, and discarded reading glasses.

features.label: art monograph bookshelf
features.inspect_text: Built-in teak shelves filled with Japanese architectural volumes, Korean indie film retrospectives, and vintage Taipei street photography books.

title: Interior Courtyard
summary: An open-air atrium framed by raw board-formed concrete. A fifty-year-old banyan tree and wild elephant-ear leaves catch the afternoon rain.
inspect_text: Natural daylight pours down three stories into this raw concrete courtyard. A mature banyan tree's aerial roots twist into a bed of smooth river stones, surrounded by giant elephant-ear leaves (guanyin-lian) and wild ferns. When summer thunderstorms break over Taipei, rain cascades down the concrete walls into a recessed gravel drain.

features.label: fifty-year banyan tree
features.inspect_text: A majestic banyan tree whose aerial roots drape down toward the river stones, its dense canopy filtering the intense subtropical sunlight into dancing dappled shadows.

features.label: carved stone bench
features.inspect_text: A smooth bench hewn from grey Guanyin stone. The stone stays cool even during the heat of mid-afternoon, making it an ideal retreat for solitary phone calls or quiet conversations.

features.label: giant elephant-ear plants
features.inspect_text: Lush tropical elephant-ear leaves the size of dinner trays. Droplets of rain or condensation glisten on their waxy green surfaces.

title: Design Studio & Library
summary: A glass-walled creative workspace overlooking the courtyard. Contains dual-monitor editing bays, drafting tables, and a vintage turntable.
inspect_text: Large iron-frame windows overlook the courtyard below. A long birch workbench holds Aera's twin calibrated color reference monitors and editing control surface. Across the room sits Yuhan's tilted drafting table covered with tracing paper blueprints, and on a low credenza, a vintage Marantz turntable spins vinyl records at low volume.

features.label: video editing station
features.inspect_text: Two 4K calibrated color grading displays, a pair of studio monitor speakers, and a jog-shuttle editing wheel. A pair of closed-back studio headphones rests on a cork block.

features.label: architectural drafting table
features.inspect_text: An adjustable wooden drafting board clamped with brass parallel bars. Rolls of butter paper and heavy blueprint tubes lean in a canvas basket.

features.label: vintage vinyl turntable
features.inspect_text: A warm walnut-cased turntable hooked up to a tube amplifier. Stacks of vinyl records include Taiwanese indie dream-pop, Japanese city pop, and quiet piano solos.

title: Girls' Dormitory
summary: An elevated tatami platform holding three low linen futons, partitioned by begonia-embossed glass and a tall industrial clothing rack.
inspect_text: Fragrant rush tatami mats cover the elevated sleeping platform, where three low linen futons are neatly made. Soft sliding partitions with begonia-embossed glass diffuse the morning light. A tall industrial steel clothing rack holds a striking cross-section of wardrobes: Aera's oversized Korean tailoring, Mio's avant-garde streetwear, and Yuhan's structured black linens.

features.label: tatami futon beds
features.inspect_text: Three minimalist floor futons dressed in crisp washed linen duvets in charcoal, unbleached flax, and pale sage. Small bedside reading lamps sit on lacquered trays.

features.label: industrial clothing rack
features.inspect_text: Heavy steel pipe rack hung with designer trench coats, vintage leather jackets, and pleated trousers. The top shelf holds hat boxes and camera cases.

features.label: shared vanity mirror
features.inspect_text: A broad vanity mirror framed by soft LED globes. The wooden surface below is crowded with expensive skincare serums, lip tints, and bottles of boutique fragrance.

title: Rooftop Terrace
summary: Weathered teak decking under a corrugated glass awning. Twin humming laundry machines, festoon fairy lights, and views of Taipei 101.
inspect_text: Warm teak boards stretch underfoot beneath a high corrugated glass roof that shelters the terrace from afternoon cloudbursts. Twin washing machines hum softly in the laundry corner, surrounded by drying racks of clothes catching the warm evening draft. Festoon lights string between steel posts, illuminating a comfortable outdoor daybed. Across the terracotta rooftops of Da'an, the spire of Taipei 101 glimmers in the night haze.

features.label: teak outdoor daybed
features.inspect_text: A deep outdoor daybed with weather-resistant charcoal cushions and throw pillows. It smells faintly of cedar and evening rain—a favorite spot for midnight beers.

features.label: laundry machines
features.inspect_text: Two commercial front-loading washers and dryers humming through rinse cycles. A bottle of eucalyptus laundry detergent sits on the dryer.

features.label: festoon string lights
features.inspect_text: Heavy outdoor string lights with vintage amber Edison bulbs, bathing the rooftop in a soft, nostalgic glow after sunset.

features.label: Taipei 101 skyline
features.inspect_text: Between the rusty metal fire escapes and water tanks of neighboring townhouses, the illuminated tiers of Taipei 101 rise into the subtropical clouds.

title: Guys' Dormitory
summary: Polished terrazzo with three industrial steel-frame beds, Daichi's road bike on a wall mount, and Kai's guitar amp in the corner.
inspect_text: Airy, clean, and masculine in an unstudied way. Polished grey terrazzo holds three black powder-coated steel beds with charcoal linen duvets. On the far brick wall, Daichi's matte-black carbon road bike hangs from precision aluminum brackets above a foam roller. In the corner sits Kai's vintage tweed guitar amplifier and guitar gig bags, beside Ren's neatly stacked Japanese culinary magazines.

features.label: steel-frame beds
features.inspect_text: Three black steel beds: Daichi's bed is made with military precision; Kai's bed has a tangled duvet and loose guitar picks; Ren's bed is flanked by a stack of culinary notebooks.

features.label: carbon road bike wall mount
features.inspect_text: An ultra-light aerodynamic racing bicycle with deep-section carbon wheels, spotless chain, and a GPS computer mount on the cockpit.

features.label: vintage guitar amp and cases
features.inspect_text: A 1970s Fender tweed combo amplifier, a beaten-up hard shell guitar case plastered with indie band stickers, and a coiled cloth instrument cable.

title: Diary Room
summary: A soundproof subterranean booth with a single wooden stool facing a two-way mirror and a high-definition studio lens.
inspect_text: Completely isolated from the house above. Sound-dampening acoustic charcoal panels line the walls, absorbing every stray frequency. A single polished wooden stool sits beneath a soft overhead key light. In front of the stool is a dark two-way mirror, behind which a hidden studio camera and teleprompter record every blink, swallow, and hesitation.

features.label: wooden interview stool
features.inspect_text: A backless oak stool bolted to the floor in the center of the key light. Anyone sitting here has nowhere to hide their body language.

features.label: two-way glass mirror
features.inspect_text: A dark pane of one-way glass. To the contestant, it reflects only their own isolated face; to the production team behind it, the camera lens is staring straight into their eyes.

features.label: overhead boom microphone
features.inspect_text: A hyper-cardioid shotgun microphone suspended from the acoustic ceiling, sensitive enough to capture whispered confessions and sharp intakes of breath.
